sloka: स च भूमिधरः श्रीमान् बलिना तेन पीडितः ।सवृक्षशिखरोदग्रः प्रविवेश रसातलम् ।। 5.56.32 ।।।।
transliteration: sa ca bhūmidharaḥ śrīmān balinā tena pīḍitaḥ ।savṛkṣaśikharodagraḥ praviveśa rasātalam ।। 5.56.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Crushed by the powerful Hanuman, that prosperous mountain with its trees standing and tall peaks sank into the underworld.
